verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents a dedicated credit-note model for refunds, returns, and adjustments against an original sale. It states that the outcome is "filings that reflect what you actually kept," so refunds flow into filings without manual fixes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how negative amounts reduce tracked liability and reporting totals, handling of refunds that cross filing periods (adjusting the next filing), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
